purpose: Defects in this project's boards that got past the checks of their day. The benchmark for a reviewer: each replayable entry is a board in git with a known defect at a known ref/pin.

fields.found_at: design (before fab) | assembler (JLC prep) | bench (after assembly) | review (later desk review)
fields.layer: reviewer layer that should catch it (see design.md): L0 identity, L1 native, L2 semantics, L3 physics, L4 mechanical, L5 interconnect, L6 fab/assembly data, L7 bring-up
fields.missed_by: the checks that passed while the defect was present
fields.replay: git ref of a defective source, or null
fields.pilot: measured result of the 2026-11-11 pilot, or null
fields.expect: bench: {board config in boards/, ref, pad?, rule?, known_miss?}: a non-note finding at that ref (and pad/rule) must appear

escapes.defect: Both USB-C receptacles (J101, USB701) placed 180 deg backwards: pads are the mirror of the Molex SD-105450-001 layout; mouth faced 8.5 mm inboard.
escapes.how: JLC engineer and owner said 'looks backwards'; confirmed 2026-09-08 against the official Molex STEP and drawing.
missed_by: KiCad renders (repo-generated STEP had the mouth on the wrong side)
escapes.cost: Y75 built with J101/USB701 DNP; copper fix deferred to next revision.
escapes.rule: Verify connector orientation only against vendor geometry (manufacturer STEP/drawing), never a repo-generated model or a render.
escapes.pilot: CAUGHT 2026-11-11 by the mouth check (courtyard vs contact pads of our footprint, no 3D model): J101 and USB701 must-fix on B2.24.5; 0 findings on B2.24.5.1.

escapes.defect: JLC engineering prep re-applied its library offset over our CPL pre-compensation (22 designators modified); JDISP1 set Assemble=No because JLC's footprint has 42 pads vs our 50.
escapes.cost: order held; manual reject with per-part instructions
escapes.rule: Predict the assembler's rotation and pad count from its own footprint (EasyEDA) and diff against ours before upload; the binding control is the Confirm Parts Placement response.

escapes.defect: 13 parts placed with wrong rotation although CPL matched KiCad.
escapes.how: JLC preview pink dot vs silk triangle.
escapes.rule: Same as E02: assembler-library rotation per part (bomcheck.py now predicts it).

escapes.defect: LED C2286: JLC pad 1 = anode, KiCad pad 1 = cathode; rotation by pad number would reverse it.
escapes.how: bomcheck.py matched polarized parts by pin function (c03a0515).
escapes.rule: Match polarized parts by pin function, not pad number.

escapes.defect: Q3 2N7002K: OVP_GATE on pin 3 (drain), FUSE_HEATER on pin 1 (gate).
escapes.how: Later datasheet review after release of B8.1.
escapes.rule: Net-name role vs pin role (and pin table vs an outside source).
escapes.pilot: CAUGHT by pinsense R: 'net OVP_GATE names a gate but lands on Q3 pin 3 (D); the gate is pin 1'. Native ERC on the same source: 0 errors.

escapes.defect: BQ28Z610 SRP/SRN Kelvin filters on the wrong sides of the shunt (SRP must be cell side).
escapes.rule: Part-specific rule card from the datasheet, checked topologically (SRP reaches the cell-side shunt terminal).
escapes.pilot: MISSED by pinsense (needs a datasheet rule card; pin names alone carry no side). Since 2026-11-11 the bq28z610 rule card (SRP reaches VSS through one resistor) is expected to catch it.

escapes.defect: BQ28Z610 and BQ294502 drawn with Connector_Generic Conn_01x13/01x07 symbols: ERC cannot reason about any pin.
escapes.rule: Active parts must have real symbols, or every pin is checked against an outside pin table.
escapes.pilot: CAUGHT by pinsense G on B8.1 and B8.2; oracle read all 20 generic pins from JLC's symbols and found no contradiction; B8.3 (real symbols): 0 findings.

escapes.defect: U701 and U707 (AP2265x USB power switches) nFAULT marked no-connect: over-current is silent. USB701 dead with VBUS 0 V; loose JUSB1 wires could current-limit KB_VBUS invisibly.
escapes.how: 2026-08-19 and 2026-09-07 bring-up; diagnosis time lost; cross-board audit 2026-09-02 'expose fault signals'.
escapes.rule: Status outputs (FAULT/PG/INT/ALERT) must reach a reader or carry a recorded reason.
escapes.pilot: CAUGHT by pinsense F (U701, U707, plus U702 PG). Native ERC: 4 errors / 282 warnings, none on these pins.

escapes.defect: U704 HD3SS3220 on a Connector_Generic Conn_01x31 symbol.
escapes.cost: unknown (risk class, no bench failure attributed)
escapes.rule: as E07
escapes.pilot: CAUGHT by pinsense G (new finding, risk only).

escapes.defect: Link 2 FFC delivered A14 J12 pin N to RH J13 pin 13-N: data lines on VBUS, nothing enumerated. Ground continuity looked right because grounds {1,4,9,12} are symmetric under reversal.
escapes.cost: bench days; footprint rotation on next spin
escapes.rule: Cross-board numbered-pin one-to-one contract; continuity plan must use asymmetric pins.

escapes.defect: J501 pad k carries HDMI contact 21-k (pin reversal); the adapters on hand use a different FFC pinout (tie 18/19/20 and 12/13).
escapes.how: 2026-10-15 photos + beep; recorded as release blocker 2026-09-23.
escapes.cost: no HDMI on B2.28 until adapter swap
escapes.rule: Contract names the exact adapter/cable SKU and its pin map; reversal is a release blocker.

escapes.defect: Original store SH-10 cable was reversed (owner re-pinned it).
escapes.rule: Catalog cable drawing with pin 1 -> 1, unpowered check on arrival (gate currently BLOCKED on it).

escapes.defect: GH-10 battery map spent four contacts per power rail and omitted PACK_NTC and PACK_PRESENT_N.
escapes.rule: Interface contract lists required safety signals per link; missing one fails.

escapes.defect: J1 Molex rotated 180 deg; stake holes are not rotationally symmetric so the part cannot be flipped in rework.
escapes.rule: Orientation vs vendor geometry and assembler library zero (E01/E02).

escapes.defect: Top-side-only assembly omitted bottom-side RN1-RN6, all six 47-ohm arrays in the LVDS path.
escapes.cost: hand work; legacy board not a release baseline
escapes.rule: Assembly coverage: every footprint with nets is assembled, or listed as post-assembly with a reason.

escapes.defect: Released with 3 ERC errors, 73 warnings, 20 DRC items incl. a courtyard overlap and copper-to-edge.
escapes.rule: Native gates run fresh from the released source, with new-vs-baseline triage.

escapes.defect: SOURCE_SHA256SUMS no longer matched build_fab.py/.sh: package stale vs the scripts that made it.
escapes.cost: package must be regenerated before reorder
escapes.rule: Bind outputs to source + build-script hashes; a review is valid only for the hash it ran on.

escapes.defect: USB pair released with 3.30 mm intra-pair length mismatch.
escapes.rule: Interface profiles (skew, coupling, vias, reference) gate, not report.

escapes.defect: 41/41 manufacturing gate passed while both USB pairs exceeded the 0.5 mm skew gate on fresh recompute; router auto-applied with 111 unknown-net diagnostics; J13 model orientation unresolved.
escapes.rule: Recompute from saved files; never accept a tool's self-report.

escapes.defect: Rotation reported complete before a matching KiCad DRC.
escapes.rule: Every claim cites a fresh, hash-bound check.

escapes.defect: Physical connector orientation/mouth problem (corrected in B6).
escapes.rule: as E01

escapes.defect: Assertion that STM32G0B1 PA9 is pin 20 (buckPG); on the actual KCU6 package PA9 is pin 19 and pin 20 is PC6.
escapes.rule: Pin tables come from the exact package (LCSC/EasyEDA symbol or datasheet), never from a family table or memory.

escapes.defect: Decision-5 value swaps missing from circuit.json (requirements drift).
escapes.rule: BOM fields, circuit.json and board values compared every release.

escapes.defect: J1 short traced to FFC contact length (cable/connector mismatch).
escapes.rule: Contract records cable contact type/length and stiffener against the connector drawing.

escapes.defect: NVMe media grows the wrong way (J701 rotation); JSD1 FFC faces backward (mutation script left it untouched); boards arrived on 70 mm assembly panel.
escapes.rule: Every connector/media keeps an asserted exit direction; order checklist states depanelized delivery.

escapes.defect: Bulk routing and skew tuning before stackup/planes/impedance/HDI policy were locked; 8/10-layer detours abandoned; 9 SI coupling warnings remained.
escapes.rule: Rules review (stack, classes, pairs, references) is a gate before routing, not after.

escapes.defect: Silkscreen reference labels unreadable: 0 of 102 visible labels clean (90 over pads, 69 stacked on other labels, 87 under another part's body, 66 below 0.15 mm stroke); 214 parts unlabelled. Native DRC: 199 silk_over_copper, 184 silk_overlap, 5 silk_edge_clearance.
escapes.how: owner looked at the 3D render (2026-11-11): 'we need better tooling for silkscreen'
missed_by: review drc check (silk warnings filed as notes)
KiCad DRC silk_overlap (strokes only: stacked labels whose boxes touch pass)
escapes.cost: a fab package with an illegible silkscreen behind a passing review gate
escapes.rule: Judge every label from exact shapes (copper with mask opening, other silk, bodies, edge, size, nearest part); place labels with a solver whose change is silk only and proved byte-identical elsewhere.
escapes.pilot: CAUGHT 2026-11-11 by the silk check: L6:SILK labels question (102 of 102 labels); silk.py place: 196 labels clean, native silk_over_copper 199 -> 2 and silk_overlap 184 -> 2 (the 4 left are part outlines, reported as L6:SILK outline).
